messages:
Nina (People Ops): Heads-up  new hire Ben is moving from the US to Canada and asked in onboarding whether his US 401(k) can be transferred into an RRSP. Any quick guidance we should include in the offer pack?

Ben (New Hire): Hi team  I asked my recruiter if I can move my 401(k) to an RRSP to simplify things. Any experience here?

Priya (Benefits): Short answer: direct tax-advantaged rollovers from a US 401(k) into a Canadian RRSP generally arent supported. Theres no automatic cross-border rollover mechanism like a domestic trustee transfer.

Sam (Payroll): Operational note: for new Canadian payroll hires we need SIN, start date, and confirmation of residency status. Pension contributions here depend on whether we enroll in a workplace plan or if employee manages RRSP individually. We dont offer a company RRSP match in Canada yet.

Mark (Legal): Add caution: cross-border tax treatment is complex. Moving funds could trigger withholding or taxable events in the US and Canada. Recommend we provide a vendor list of cross-border tax advisors; avoid giving tax advice ourselves.

Priya (Benefits): I'll draft a one-paragraph FAQ to add to the onboarding packet: - Explain theres typically no direct tax-free transfer; - Typical options: (1) leave 401(k) in US plan, (2) roll to a US IRA, (3) cash out (tax consequences), or (4) seek bespoke transfer advice from a cross-border specialist.

Nina (People Ops): Can we also add a line telling them well provide payroll setup steps and timing for any Canadian payroll deductions? Ben wants to know when contributions would start.

Sam (Payroll): We'll start Canadian payroll on first pay run after start date; if company-sponsored retirement options get added later, contributions would start per that program's effective date. For now treat as employee-managed RRSP.

Ben (New Hire): Thanks  appreciated. If I want the advisor list, whom do I ask?

Mark (Legal): Send an email to people-ops@redwood.com and we'll share a short list of firms our employees have used. Include a disclaimer: informational only, not an endorsement.

Priya (Benefits): Drafted FAQ uploaded to /Benefits/Internal/Intl-Rollover-Notes. Contents include GOV links for US and CRA links for Canada, plus the vendor list note.

PayrollBot: Payroll task created  add Canada hire (employee ID 11345) to payroll runs and flag for SIN verification. (task# 8019)

Nina (People Ops): Great. Ben  well add the FAQ link to your offer email and include contact for advisor list. Welcome aboard! :tada:
